$comment: Registry of pre-baked Cys-warhead link CIF templates.
Each entry maps a SMARTS pattern to a link CIF + mod2 variant.
The runtime detector matches SMARTS in declared order and uses the first hit.
See README.md for the full architecture and placeholder-token semantics.

warheads.name: Cys-S to alpha,beta-ynamide post-product (vinyl thioether)
warheads.$comment: Matches the post-reaction form: vinyl-thioether C=C drawn between S and the carbonyl. Used when the ligand was uploaded as the bound state (XQQ-style chem_comp in 8FD9).

warheads.name: Cys-S to alpha,beta-ynamide (alkyne pre-reaction form)
warheads.$comment: Matches the free-drug alkyne form: R-C#C-C(=O)-N. The mod2 transforms triple->double, adds H on Calpha, retypes sp->sp2. Triggered when the user pastes the PubChem SMILES.

warheads.name: Cys-S to terminal propiolamide (HC#C-C(=O)-N, Spebrutinib-class)
warheads.$comment: Terminal-alkyne sub-variant. Same mod2 as 'pre' but the resulting Cb has H instead of an R group. Plan-doc §A.3 adds one extra angle restraint at runtime for SG-Cb-H.

warheads.name: Cys-S to acrylamide post-product (saturated beta-thioether)
warheads.$comment: Matches the post-reaction form: saturated sp3-sp3 -S-CH(R)-CH2-C(=O)N- (no C=C). Distinct from F2 vinyl-thioether by SMARTS bond order between :1 and :2. Use when the ligand was uploaded as the bound state with sp3 carbons (e.g. ibrutinib in 5P9I).

warheads.name: Cys-S to acrylamide (alkene pre-reaction form)
warheads.$comment: Matches the free-drug alkene form: R-CH=CH-C(=O)-N. The mod2 transforms double->single, adds H on Calpha, retypes sp2->sp3. Internal-alkene variant. NOTE: this SMARTS is more general than CYS-YNA-pre/pre-terminal so the F2-pre entries above must come FIRST in this registry — they're more specific (triple bond) and should match before falling through to this F1-pre entry.

warheads.name: Cys-S to terminal acrylamide (CH2=CH-C(=O)-N, Ibrutinib-class)
warheads.$comment: Terminal-acrylamide sub-variant (H2C=CHC(=O)N). Same mod2 as CYS-ACR-pre but Cb has 2H pre-reaction, one of which becomes the SG attachment site. The JS detector appends one extra angle restraint at runtime for SG-Cb-H (109.5°, sp3 tetrahedral).

warheads.name: Cys-S to alpha-chloroacetamide post-product (saturated beta-thioether)
warheads.$comment: F3 family: SN2 displacement of Cl from -C(=O)-CH2-Cl by Cys-S. Distinguishable from F1-post (sat. thioether) by Cβ being DIRECTLY bonded to the carbonyl-C (no Cα between them). Post-product form has the Cl already gone — ligand was uploaded as the bound state with sp3 -S-CH2-C(=O)-N-.

warheads.name: Cys-S to alpha-chloroacetamide (Cl pre-reaction form)
warheads.$comment: Matches the free-drug form: R-N-C(=O)-CH2-Cl. The mod2 deletes Cl and the Cβ-Cl bond (no H added, unlike Michael additions — SN2 just swaps Cl→S without protonation). Triggered when the user pastes a chloroacetamide-bearing SMILES.

warheads.name: Cys-S to maleimide post-Michael adduct (3-thiosuccinimide, sat. ring)
warheads.$comment: Saturated 3-thiosuccinimide form: Cβ and Cα are both sp3 in the closed 5-ring; the two ring carbonyls share an amide-N. Distinguishable from F1-post by the ring-closure (Cβ has a second carbonyl-C neighbour besides the chain Cα-CO; that second carbonyl shares its amide-N with the Cα-side carbonyl).

warheads.name: Cys-S to maleimide (ring C=C pre-reaction form)
warheads.$comment: Maleimide ring with C=C still drawn (free-probe form). The mod2 transforms ring C=C → C-C single + adds H on Cα + retypes both sp2→sp3. Cβ keeps its single H (unlike F1-pre-terminal where Cβ has 2H pre-reaction). Detected by checking that Cβ's =Cα is bonded to a carbonyl whose amide-N is shared with another carbonyl-C that's a SECOND single-bond neighbour of Cβ (the 5-ring closure).
